UPDATE: VARCHAR and TEXT have identical storage and performance in Postgres. Both use varlena, both incur the same read cost. The difference is write-time: VARCHAR enforces the length constraint, TEXT doesn't.

For your description column, the read performance is the same either way. Pick TEXT if unbounded length is plausible, VARCHAR(2000) if you want the database to reject longer strings.
